description: LOCAL context only. The main window is a remote loopback URL, so nothing here reaches it — the updater/relaunch IPC its banner needs is granted at runtime, scoped to the exact http://127.0.0.1:<port> origin (grant_spa_update_ipc in src/lib.rs). The splash window IS local: it draws the start-up progress and the stop cards, and it talks to the shell only through this app's own boot_status / boot_action commands, which need no plugin permission and are refused for any window but 'splash'.
